📐 Continuous Pressure Index Mathematical Formulation

The continuous Pressure Index (PI) evaluates match leverage ball-by-ball. Unlike discrete heuristics, it handles non-linear compounding of run-rate urgency and wicket loss.

1. Run Rate Urgency

L_req = clip((RRR - 6.0) / 10.0, 0, 1)

Scales leverage linearly from 6.0 RPO (baseline) to 16.0 RPO (extreme).

2. Resource Depletion

W_adj = Wickets_Lost / 9.0

Measures remaining batting resources and collapse exposure.

3. Death Urgency

D_exp = exp(-Balls_Remaining / 30.0)

Exponential escalation as deliveries run out in the death overs.

4. Match Consistency Factor

Multiplier = 0.75 + 0.25 / (1 + CV_match)

Penalizes volatile boom-or-bust performers; rewards ice-cool repeatability across matches.
